summary: Datadog is US IT company, founded in 2010. Type: listed company. About 10,234 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 92% of its 13 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 2 about funding; 4 about acquisitions; 3 about growth or hiring; 1 about legal trouble, strikes or bankruptcy.

insights.one_liner: US cloud monitoring and security software company; its Amsterdam jobs are mostly sales roles in English, and it is an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: Of its 13 open jobs here, 9 are in sales and account management and 11 are based in Amsterdam.
A big tech company with about 10,234 people on LinkedIn, mostly from computer science, business and marketing; top schools include CentraleSupélec, Northeastern, Waterloo and NYU.
Says it supports remote, hybrid and office ways of working rather than one fixed model.
Describes its culture as grounded in humility and a wish to learn, with employee-run community guilds.

open.text: Datadog Netherlands B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor, so it can hire you on a highly skilled migrant visa.
92% of its 13 jobs here don't ask for Dutch, though none mention visa or relocation support.
Its careers site lists 110 open positions across EMEA and 56 remote ones, next to 237 in the Americas.

growth.text: Founded in 2010 in New York and listed on Nasdaq.
Headline reports that Datadog's global expansion is speeding up.
Headline says its expansion with large enterprise customers is accelerating.

worth_knowing.text: Palo Alto Networks' CEO reportedly held acquisition talks with both Okta and Datadog.
